prompt:
Create ONE static illustration asset for a polished small strategy game's equipment selection card, landscape 2:1 composition. Semi-realistic hand-painted miniature game art, clean detailed forms, soft ambient light, restrained olive/teal/brass palette, pale ivory-sage background, excellent legibility at 260 pixels wide. All subjects fully contained in central 80% of frame, strong clear silhouettes, generous negative space. Not flat SVG diagrams, not a UI screenshot. No text, no labels, no numbers, no card border, no logos, no decorative arrows. Depict the equipment's distinguishing behavior visually as one crisp frozen moment. No ground plane shadows or oval base patches.
SUBJECT: A fictional strategy-game time-delay attachment icon. A brass timing dial with two clock hands and no numerals sits beside a small teal energy capsule. At the right, a stylized red wooden training target is surrounded by an amber ring that is just beginning to flare into a soft radial burst of light. Clearly convey waiting briefly before an effect activates. Polished hand-painted game illustration, not a real engineering diagram. No text and no construction details.
